rows.label: T3E.7 — fundamental reconciliation and strongest countercase — paragraph 1

cells.text: Actual prior CP-4A reports 196.2% published statutory asset coverage against a150% after-borrowing minimum, 46.2 percentage points of published ratio cushion. This is an asset-value incurrence measure, not cash, complete compliance, recovery or a market PD. Classification versus the conditional spread/default model is not_comparable; a full matching CP-2/2G/2H fundamental/rating view is absent in this market case. Positive statutory cushion and nonzero market compensation can coexist without contradiction. No artificial rating divergence or fundamental-to-market probability calibration is asserted.

rows.label: T3E.7 — fundamental reconciliation and strongest countercase — paragraph 2

cells.text: Downside mechanism: deteriorating portfolio values/income can reduce coverage and funding flexibility, while risk premiums/rates or poor liquidity depress note value. The later consequence depends on actual cash/access and maturities; this map does not quantify an issuer default path. The strongest countercase to reading discounted low-coupon bonds as distress is coupon/rate/maturity mechanics and the published positive coverage snapshot. It wins over a distress inference until matched quotes and issuer-specific asset-quality/funding evidence support one. It does not establish the correct current credit assessment.

runs.text: Both securities: Requires More Work; RV Unclear. Positive comparative work now establishes what the apparent compensation difference actually depends on. If both annual equivalents are clean, July's maturity yield exceeds March's by 2.210154bp, but the same-date Treasury-tenor adjustment leaves only 0.160839bp of simple residual difference. Source fair values are rounded to USDm: an analyst nearest-million display-precision sensitivity, varying each value independently by±0.5USDm, makes the yield gap range from −0.616287 to5.036816bp. A precise ordering is not supported in that case.

If both equivalents are dirty, July's extra yield is18.522010bp and simple residual difference16.472695bp; rounding alone leaves that yield ordering positive. That is the strongest compensation countercase for July, but neither price basis nor executable depth is established. The basis need not be identical across separately estimated values. July also has longer remaining maturity and greater conditional duration, so a yield difference is not free compensation. No current Cheap/Fair/Rich or Preferred label is justified by those alternatives.

runs.text: The decision remains Requires More Work, rather than a manufactured Preferred/Secondary ordering. The next evidence action is now narrower and more useful: settle the actual basis/precision/depth first, then assess whether compensation survives the fundamental, structural, call and funding trade-offs. Both notes retain the shared borrower-realization/asset-mark/funding-access downside chain. Different maturity dates do not remove that common issuer risk.

runs.text: All ten rows below are distinct Ares Capital Corporation parent senior unsecured USD series, matched by issuer/coupon/maturity tuple. Only July2029 has the full selected executed supplement: CUSIP04010LBG7, ISIN US04010LBG77, 5.950%, Jul15 2029. Issuer swap economics do not change noteholder cash flows. Annual p95 describes effective subordination to secured collateral and structural subordination to subsidiary/financing-vehicle claims; identical covenant/call terms across all series are not established. No CLO/facility observation is mixed into this group.

Source class for every issuer value: estimated/evaluated, Level2, as of 2024-12-31, exact time unknown, based on applicable market rates or quotes if available. These are rounded aggregate issuer financial disclosures, not observed per100 clean bid/mid/offer prices or last trades. No market-open/executable status is established. The Treasury row is same-date indicative bid-side-derived par rates, approximately3:30pm source methodology, not an executable corporate quote.

Freshness: historical/outdated now, deliberately usable for the user's functional proof. ARCC's audit is dated February5 2025; this is not a December31 information-availability backtest. No “maintained current” loan-workbook rule is imported into this historical fixed-bond case.

HL reports investment income2,990 versus2,614 USDm and NII1,403 versus1,266; net operations1,522 in both years, diluted EPS2.44 versus2.68. Higher aggregate NII is meaningful contrary evidence to a blanket deterioration view. It does not settle per-share or cash durability. Non-accruals rose from1.3% to1.7% at cost and0.6% to1.0% at fair value, while the internal average grade remained3.1 (A73,116). Investment marks and borrower realization affect the BDC's creditor buffer; cost and fair-value non-accrual percentages are separate denominators.

HL's CFO used2,128 USDm versus provided511 includes investment deployment. PIK recognition and collections have different timing/cohorts; no industrial CFO-minus-capex burn rate or contemporaneous PIK cash-conversion percentage is invented. Ordinary cash635 USDm differs from restricted225; approximately5.1USDbn facility availability is conditional (A88,115,255). Neither is an unconditional refinancing bridge. H4A's published46.2pp coverage cushion is positive snapshot evidence, not dollars available or a maintenance-test clearance. Financial policy includes actual1,139 USDm dividends and1,364 USDm common-stock net proceeds; authorization is distinct from executed repurchases (HL/A255).

Causal downside: borrower non-performance or weaker marks → reduced realized income/qualifying asset value → pressure on cash realization, borrowing-base access and statutory incurrence flexibility → less flexibility around upcoming funding uses. Both parent unsecured notes share that issuer channel and priority behind secured collateral/subsidiary creditors; their different maturities do not diversify it. Monitor the next borrower/cash/coverage disclosure and each actual financing's dated uses/access certificate. No timing-to-default or PD is inferred.
